findings.summary: list_ready builds the onboarding overlay with an empty slice instead of the real onboarding_libs, so it always evaluates to "" — silently dropping the onboarding-sample filter from list_ready's SQL.
findings.mechanism: `onboarding_overlay_clause(&[])` ignores the `onboarding_libs` parameter passed into `list_ready`, so `overlay` is always `String::new()` regardless of what onboarding libraries are configured. The generated SQL then omits the `AND (onboarding_sample = 1 OR ...)` clause entirely, while the code below still pushes one bind value per entry in `onboarding_libs` into `binds` (used for `library`, overlay placeholders, then `limit`). Since the SQL has zero `?` placeholders for the overlay but `binds` still contains those onboarding_libs values in that position, the bind values shift into the wrong `?` slots (e.g. clobbering the LIMIT placeholder) or the call fails outright with an "incorrect number of parameters" error whenever `onboarding_libs` is non-empty — this both breaks the invariant that list_ready mirrors claim_next's claimable set (unsampled onboarding rows now show up in list_ready) and can corrupt/crash the LIMIT-bound query.
